description: The item's nutrition panel as a given country would print it (rounding, basis, mandatory nutrients, salt vs sodium, carbohydrate definition). Values that cannot be derived exactly come back null with the reason; derived rows (salt from sodium, kJ from kcal) list derived_from. "allergens" lists every allergen the source states the item contains, and "may_contain" every allergen of its precautionary ("may contain") statement, as canonical keys: none is ever dropped, in any regime. Where the regime declares a stated allergen under a broader key (barley, rye, oats and wheat under gluten in CA, EU, UK and CODEX; an almond under tree_nut), the broader key is added after the stated ones, with a note; a stated allergen the regime has no key for is shown as stated, with a note. Each is null, with a note, when no source states it, and [] only when a source states the item contains none.

id.description: Entity id, e.g. fd_k3m9x2q8vt7w4p (food), pr_ (product), sp_ (supplement), mi_ (menu item), rc_ (recipe). A source id also works: fdc:<USDA fdcId>, ndb:<NDB number>, dsld:<DSLD id>, fndds:<food code>, lnhpd:<LNHPD id>, ciqual:<alim_code>, cnf:<food code>, cofid:<food code>, matvaretabellen:<food id>, slv:<Livsmedelsverket number>.

regime.description: US, CA, EU, UK, AU_NZ, JP, CN, CODEX
